q: Landauer's principle states that erasing one bit of information dissipates at least:
exp: Landauer (1961): erasing 1 bit reduces entropy by k_B ln 2, which must be transferred to the environment as heat Q ≥ k_BT ln 2 (second law). This resolves Maxwell's demon: the demon must erase its memory, paying the thermodynamic cost of the information it acquired.
